questions.question:
In MATCH … SEARCH … VECTOR INDEX … LIMIT k, what does LIMIT k specify?

MATCH (q:Question)
	SEARCH q IN (
		VECTOR INDEX question_embeddings
		FOR $embedding
		LIMIT 10
	)
RETURN q
options: The number of results to return (top k).

questions.question:
Complete the Python code to create an embedding using the OpenAI API:

from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key)

response = client.embeddings.-- select --
	model="text-embedding-ada-002",
	input="What is a knowledge graph?"
)

embedding = response.data[0].embedding
Which of the following are valid strategies for chunking text data?
options: N-Grams - creating chunks of n consecutive words or characters.
Size - splitting data into equal-sized chunks.
Topic Segmentation - dividing text based on topic changes.
Randomization - splitting text at random positions.

questions.question: What do knowledge graphs provide to enable comprehensive understanding of information?
options: Structured representation of entities, attributes, and their relationships.
Pre-computed query results for all possible questions.

questions.question: What is the tradeoff between vector dimensionality and performance?
options: Higher dimensionality captures more meaning but is computationally expensive.

questions.question:
Complete the Python code to create a Neo4j vector retriever in LangChain:

from langchain_community.vectorstores.neo4j_vector import Neo4jVector

vector_store = Neo4jVector.-- select --
	embedding=embedding_provider,
	url=NEO4J_URI,
	username=NEO4J_USERNAME,
	password=NEO4J_PASSWORD,
	index_name="question_embeddings"
)
Which of the following are valid types of embedding models?
options: Word2Vec - generates word embeddings based on context.
Universal Sentence Encoder - converts sentences into embeddings.
Node2Vec - generates embeddings based on random walks through a graph.
GraphQL - generates embeddings for API queries.

Semantic search is faster than keyword search.
Keyword search provides more accurate results.
